topic.title: Isolation Techniques
topic.shortdesc: A survey of practical isolation techniques used in modern container runtimes.

section.title: Linux Namespaces
section.p: Namespaces partition kernel resources so that each set of processes sees its own isolated instance of the global resource. Key namespace types include:

dlentry.dd: Isolates the process ID number space.
Provides an isolated network stack with its own interfaces and routing tables.
Isolates the set of filesystem mount points.

section.title: Seccomp-BPF Filters
section.p: Seccomp-BPF allows a process to install a Berkeley Packet Filter program that restricts which system calls the kernel will execute on its behalf. This reduces the kernel attack surface available to a sandboxed workload.
